w_workflows.name: Develop and manage service delivery operations
w_workflows.description: Developing and managing different delivery services using service delivery systems for operational activities within the IT function in order to achieve organizations goal.

w_workflows.name: Manage infrastructure resource administration
w_workflows.description: Managing the resources required for administration of IT infrastructure. Manage the IT inventory and assets. Take care of the organization's IT resource capacity.

w_workflows.name: Operate IT user support
w_workflows.description: Managing systematic user support functionality and capability through defined procedures. Determine, record, and monitor user requests. Execute issue/request resolution. Utilize escalation path when needed. Resolve issue/request.

w_workflows.name: Perform planning/budgeting/forecasting
w_workflows.description: Allocating funds to meet future and current financial goals. Led by the chief financial officer, have the finance function plan, budget, and forecast in order to determine and describe long and short-term financial goals.

w_workflows.name: Perform cost accounting and control
w_workflows.description: Defining costs to be incurred and methods for optimum utilization. Determine the costs of products, processes, projects, etc. to compile in the financial statements, as well as to assist management in making decisions regarding planning and control. Control costs by managing and reducing business expenses.

w_workflows.name: Perform cost management
w_workflows.description: Deciding which expenses can be avoided to reduce some costs and increase revenues. Plan and control the organization's budget to forecast future expenditures.

w_workflows.name: Evaluate and manage financial performance
w_workflows.description: Checking and achieving predetermined financial targets and timelines. Assess and manage the profitability, feasibility, and consistency of a business or project. Study the revenues generated.

w_workflows.name: Process customer credit
w_workflows.description: Evaluating and processing requests for advances. Evaluate credit requests by customers requiring loans to buy products/services.

w_workflows.name: Invoice customer
w_workflows.description: Preparing detailed reports of customer purchases. Prepare a commercial document between the seller and customer with details about transaction. Detail the quantity purchased, price of products/services, date, parties involved, unique invoice number, and tax information.

w_workflows.name: Process accounts receivable (AR)
w_workflows.description: Processing payments due from customers. This includes all processing of funds received, whether by check or electronically. This does not include the generation of invoices.

w_workflows.name: Manage and process collections
w_workflows.description: Posting entries to respective accounts, and preparing accounts for receivables. Manage the cash collected by the business from its debtors. Record it in the books of accounts to provide clear information about the availability of the cash.

w_workflows.name: Manage and process adjustments/deductions
w_workflows.description: Creating and providing funds for necessary adjustments and deductions, including all expenses that were required for the business at certain point in time.

w_workflows.name: Manage policies and procedures
w_workflows.description: Creating procedures to perform general accounting and reporting. Follow the rules and regulations made for a particular process in the business. Publish accounting policies.

w_workflows.name: Perform general accounting
w_workflows.description: Applying basic principles, concepts, and accounting practices in recording and preparing final accounts, and using accounting information in management.

w_workflows.name: Perform fixed-asset accounting
w_workflows.description: Accounting for long-term and fixed assets. Record purchased, fixed assets that are not easily convertible into cash. Account for costs, useful life, resale value, depreciation, and amortization.

w_workflows.name: Perform financial reporting
w_workflows.description: Reporting on the organization's financial status to stakeholders. Include balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and statements of shareholders' equity.

w_workflows.name: Perform capital planning and project approval
w_workflows.description: Preparing a project finance report to solicit approvals in capital projects. Prepare budgets for projects that require heavy investments. Report on project finances to solicit approvals from management.

w_workflows.name: Perform capital project accounting
w_workflows.description: Accounting for large-scale and large-cost investments. Manage and account for ongoing activities related to capital projects, including setting up new projects, recording project transactions, monitoring and tracking spending, closing and capitalizing projects, and measuring the financial returns on completed projects.

w_workflows.name: Report time
w_workflows.description: Recording the reporting time of employees on-site. Track working days, salary calculations, holidays taken, number of hours spend in the office, billing hours, etc.

w_workflows.name: Manage pay
w_workflows.description: Managing the total payments made in employees payroll, including bonuses and compensation.

w_workflows.name: Manage and process payroll taxes
w_workflows.description: Deducting and paying taxes from employees' salaries.

w_workflows.name: Process accounts payable (AP)
w_workflows.description: Processing payments of operating expenses and other supplier charges. This includes the development of policies and procedures around processing of accounts payable and all operations. This process is often supported by key technology enablers.

w_workflows.name: Process expense reimbursements
w_workflows.description: Processing reimbursements to employees for the expenses incurred during the course of business. Approve and process advancements and reimbursements for employee expenses on the organization's behalf. Capture and report relevant tax data and manage personal accounts.

w_workflows.name: Manage corporate credit cards
w_workflows.description: Handling and authoring credit cards to business entities or for corporate purchases.

w_workflows.name: Manage treasury policies and procedures
w_workflows.description: Managing rules and regulations for investments in trading in bonds, currencies, financial derivatives, etc. Establish policies and procedures for investments made. Optimize liquidity in treasury operations.

w_workflows.name: Manage cash
w_workflows.description: Taking care of all cash-related activities in the business. Manage and reconcile cash positions. Manage cash equivalents. Process and oversee electronic fund transfers. Develop cash flow forecasts. Manage cash flows. Produce cash management accounting transactions and reports. Manage and oversee banking relationships. Analyze, negotiate, resolve, and confirm bank fees.

w_workflows.name: Manage in-house bank accounts
w_workflows.description: Managing financial services provided by an in-house bank structure in the corporation that is operating like a commercial bank.

w_workflows.name: Manage debt and investment
w_workflows.description: Taking care of the organization's financial position. Manage its loans or debts from different sources and investments. Leverage the most profitable options to balance the financial position in the market.

w_workflows.name: Monitor and execute risk and hedging transactions
w_workflows.description: Performing transactions that limit investment risk with the help of derivatives, such as options and futures contracts. Manage interest rates, foreign exchange, and exposure risks. Develop and execute hedging transactions. Evaluate and refine hedging positions. Produce hedge accounting transactions and reports. Monitor credit.

w_workflows.name: Manage financial fraud/dispute cases
w_workflows.description: Handling cases that involve financial fraud. Resolve disputes.

w_workflows.name: Establish internal controls, policies, and procedures
w_workflows.description: Forming rules and regulations to ensure the achievement of effectiveness, proficiency of operations, and reliability of financial reporting.

w_workflows.name: Operate controls and monitor compliance with internal controls policies and procedures
w_workflows.description: Incorporating planning, management, operations, and monitoring of internal control mechanism policies and procedures in order to manage internal controls. Design and implement control activities. Monitor control effectiveness. Remediate control deficiencies. Create compliance functions. Operate compliance functions. Implement and maintain technologies and tools to enable the internal controls-related activities.

w_workflows.name: Report on internal controls compliance
w_workflows.description: Reporting on internal controls compliance to the appropriate authority, including IT regulations and pertinent data.

w_workflows.name: Develop tax strategy and plan
w_workflows.description: Setting targets for periodic tax liabilities. Assess the tax impact of various activities such as the acquisition or disposal of fixed assets or a deliberate change in number of employee.

w_workflows.name: Process taxes
w_workflows.description: Processing the taxes of the organization in line with the regional taxation structure, including corporate, property, excise, and service taxes.

w_workflows.name: Manage international funds/consolidation
w_workflows.description: Managing cash collections and disbursements made by operating units across the enterprise. When appropriate, transfer cash from the operating units to parent-level bank accounts managed by the organization's treasury team.

w_workflows.name: Perform global trade services
w_workflows.description: Making and collecting payments for transactions in products/services, and transporting them to interested markets.

w_workflows.name: Develop property strategy and long term vision
w_workflows.description: Strategizing a long-term vision for managing properties. Prepare strategies and a long-term vision for managing purchased/retained properties.

w_workflows.name: Plan facility
w_workflows.description: Recognizing the needs of facility users in order to construct a project proposal that meets those needs.

w_workflows.name: Provide workspace and facilities
w_workflows.description: Managing the provision of the workspace and its assets. Arrange an office space with all assets (tables, chairs, computers, admin staff, etc.) according to requirements.

w_workflows.name: Manage facilities operations
w_workflows.description: Managing all operational activities of the facility. Manage how each function/business unit works. Support the manufacturing facility to attain organizational goals.

w_workflows.name: Manage capital program for productive assets
w_workflows.description: Producing and maintaining a planning schedule and a financial plan to purchase or manufacture productive assets. Determine the investment plan, monitor capital, and secure the necessary financing in order to realize completion of the program.

w_workflows.name: Design and plan asset construction
w_workflows.description: Outlining the steps and strategies needed to construct assets. Verify that all regulations are adhered to and that all permissions have been granted. Organize and plan for resources to complete construction.

w_workflows.name: Schedule and perform construction work
w_workflows.description: Arranging a timetable for which to perform construction work. Schedule resources to contract assets for new or replacement assets. Reschedule or redesign assets if needed.

w_workflows.name: Manage asset construction
w_workflows.description: Overseeing the performance and quality of work. Assure that records are maintained throughout the construction process. Adhere to all safety, security, and access regulations set forth by the organization and all government standards.

w_workflows.name: Plan asset maintenance
w_workflows.description: Ensuring that necessary resources are available and tasks are prioritized accordingly through planning. Provide strategies and policies that identify tasks that need to be completed, and the resources necessary to fulfill those tasks.

w_workflows.name: Manage asset maintenance
w_workflows.description: Ensuring that asset maintenance is conducted in a timely manner and successfully. Schedule work with the required resources with an eye on quality control and safety. Verify that contracted maintenance meets performance targets.

w_workflows.name: Perform asset maintenance
w_workflows.description: Engaging in all aspects of asset maintenance. Ensure that all assets are functioning properly and to all specified codes and regulations where applicable. Maintenance includes all preventative, routine, and corrective activates.

w_workflows.name: Decommission productive assets
w_workflows.description: Retiring assets that are no longer viable to the business. Decommission assets that are no longer in working order, are out of date, or whose maintenance exceeds the cost of replacement.

w_workflows.name: Perform waste and hazardous goods management
w_workflows.description: Disposing of waste and hazardous materials as outlined by state, local, and federal regulations.

w_workflows.name: Establish the enterprise risk framework and policies
w_workflows.description: Creating an agenda for the rules and regulations of enterprise risk that deal with hazardous, financial, operational, and strategic risks.

w_workflows.name: Oversee and coordinate enterprise risk management activities
w_workflows.description: Coordinating to plan, organize, lead, and control the activities of an organization in order to minimize the special effects of risk on capital and earnings.

w_workflows.name: Coordinate business unit and functional risk management activities
w_workflows.description: Coordinating risk management activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats. Specify the organization's objectives. Assign resources to project objectives.

w_workflows.name: Manage business unit and function risk
w_workflows.description: Analyzing the threats a business unit/function faces to prioritize the controls it implements..

w_workflows.name: Establish compliance framework and policies
w_workflows.description: Developing a set of procedures detailing an organization's progress in complying with established guidelines, provisions, and legislation.

w_workflows.name: Manage regulatory compliance
w_workflows.description: Obeying laws, guidelines, strategies, and stipulations related to the business.

w_workflows.name: Create remediation plans
w_workflows.description: Creating plans for remediation efforts. Make a plan to address a case of environmental adulteration. Identify and treat the adulteration so that the area will become operational again.

w_workflows.name: Amend or create policy
w_workflows.description: Crafting a new framework of policies and procedures for deploying remediation efforts, or change existing policies and procedures. Adapt the policy structure to the context of the apposite national and international regulatory frameworks.

w_workflows.name: Maintain continuous business operations
w_workflows.description: Evaluating business operations. Determine which activities generate revenues, perform best, and provide good returns.

w_workflows.name: Share knowledge of specific risks across other parts of the organization
w_workflows.description: Sharing information about risks and resilience strategies of business operations across the organization so that prospective risks can be avoided.

w_workflows.name: Plan, build, and manage stakeholder relations
Manage government relations
w_workflows.description: Persuading public and government policy at the local, regional, national, and global level (subject to government regulations).

w_workflows.name: Manage relations with quasi-government bodies
w_workflows.description: Managing relations with quasi-governmental organizations, corporations, businesses, or any other agency that is treated by national laws and principles to be under the supervision of the government but also distinct and self-directed from the government.

w_workflows.name: Manage relations with trade or industry groups
w_workflows.description: Managing relations with organizations established and financed by businesses that operate in a specific industry. Participate in public relations actions such as lobbying and publishing, advertising, education, and political donations.

w_workflows.name: Create ethics policies
w_workflows.description: Creating a code of ethics that communicate the organization's philosophy to employees, vendors, customers, clients, and the public.

w_workflows.name: Manage corporate governance policies
w_workflows.description: Administering the system of rules, practices, and processes through which a company is directed and controlled. Balance stakeholder interests including shareholders, management, customers, suppliers, financiers, government, and the community. Outline a strategy for achieving organizational goals, from action plans and internal controls to performance measurement and corporate disclosure.

w_workflows.name: Ensure compliance
w_workflows.description: Ensuring the organization's compliance position. Validate compliance with different statutes, regulatory directions, and legal principles (using Establish compliance framework and policies [17468]). Coordinate with compliance and risk management personnel.

w_workflows.name: Manage outside counsel
w_workflows.description: Managing professionals, sought externally for assistance over legal and ethical concerns. Administer and oversee assistance from subject matter experts and professionals for sourcing expert opinion and counseling over legal and ethical matters.

w_workflows.name: Protect intellectual property
w_workflows.description: Safeguarding the intellectual property of the organization. This process requires the organization to protect a wide variety of intellectual property created by it. It involves creating and managing non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), following up on current developments in the areas where the organization holds patents, tracking the use of the organization's copyrighted material, creating and upholding licensing terms, and administering policies for safeguarding intellectual property.

w_workflows.name: Manage public relations program
w_workflows.description: Managing a public relations programs through business and communications skills.

w_workflows.name: Establish and maintain process management governance
w_workflows.description: Defining and managing the organization's approach to governing business process management. Establish and manage tools to support the governance process. Assign ownership for all business processes. Perform activities to administer the governing process.

w_workflows.name: Define and manage process frameworks
w_workflows.description: Determining and organizing the structural composition of business processes. Design, establish, and administer the framework. Identify any cross-functional processes that are mandatory for achieving business excellence.

w_workflows.name: Define processes
w_workflows.description: Outlining and establishing the business processes of the organization. Scope, analyze, map, and publish processes for the employees who may require it.

w_workflows.name: Manage process performance
w_workflows.description: Evaluating and handling the performance of business processes. Provide training to process owners. Support the execution of business processes. Measure and report the performance of the business processes.

w_workflows.name: Improve processes
w_workflows.description: Identifying and choosing improvement opportunities. Create and manage improvement projects. Perform the improvement activities continuously and routinely.

w_workflows.name: Manage portfolio
w_workflows.description: Managing the business portfolio of the organization, including investments, holdings, products, businesses, and brands. Establish a portfolio strategy. Define portfolio governance. Monitor and control the portfolio.

w_workflows.name: Manage programs
w_workflows.description: Establishing, implementing, and managing business programs. Successfully handle related projects that together constitute a program. Establish the program structure and approach. Coordinate with stakeholders and partners. Execute the program. Assess and report the performance of the program. Coordinate and prioritize resources across projects. Manage links between the projects and the overall costs and risks of the program.

w_workflows.name: Manage projects
w_workflows.description: Establishing the scope of the projects. Create plans for implementing the projects. Initiate projects. Review and report project performance to management. Close projects.

w_workflows.name: Establish quality requirements
w_workflows.description: Determining essential activities, processes, and attributes for securing enterprise quality. Outline critical characteristics for quality. Outline activities encouraging the preservation of quality. Create quality controls. Confirm capabilities in accordance with quality requirements. Finalize the plan for quality maintenance.

w_workflows.name: Evaluate performance to requirements
w_workflows.description: Analyzing if the performance of the quality plan has achieved the estimated and desired requirements. Conduct tests against the quality plan. Assess the results of these tests.

w_workflows.name: Manage non-conformance
w_workflows.description: Handling any nonconformance activities or events. Assess the potential impact of the nonconformity. Decide the immediate actions to take. Identify the root causes. Take corrective or preventive action. Ensure future conformance.

w_workflows.name: Implement and maintain the enterprise quality management system (EQMS)
w_workflows.description: Establishing and administering the software that manages content and business processes for quality and compliance across the value chain. Define the quality strategy. Plan and deploy the EQMS scope, targets, and goals. Identify core process controls and metric. Develop EQMS governance. Assess the performance of EQMS. Encourage improvements in EQMS.

w_workflows.name: Plan for change
w_workflows.description: Crafting a plan for implementing change to the organization's multiple frameworks, systems, and functional areas. Chart a schematic plan that gives the organization a foundation to shape its change efforts.

w_workflows.name: Design the change
w_workflows.description: Developing plans for change management, training, communication, and rewards/incentives. Establish metrics for measuring the change adoption. Clarify new roles for employees. Identify budgets.

w_workflows.name: Implement change
w_workflows.description: Effectuating the change within the desired impact areas of the organization. Ensure adequate commitment from all corners of the organization for the desired change. Create support structures. Refashion all processes deemed necessary. Observe the progress.

w_workflows.name: Sustain improvement
w_workflows.description: Sustaining the impact of the change process in order to enact continual process improvement. Monitor the performance of re-engineered business processes. Identify best practices and potential issues. Effectuate remedial steps.

w_workflows.name: Develop KM strategy
w_workflows.description: Creating a plan for managing the organization's knowledge base. Determine what kind of specialized knowledge the organization possesses, which elements of this collective knowledge can prove beneficial, how to capture and maintain this knowledge, how to grant access to this library of information, and how the organization should proceed.

w_workflows.name: Assess KM capabilities
w_workflows.description: Assessing the maturity of the existing initiatives in knowledge management, and evaluating existing KM approaches. Identify the gaps and needs in order to enhance the existing KM approaches. Develop and implement new KM approaches.

w_workflows.name: Design and implement KM capabilities
w_workflows.description: Creating knowledge bases and other repositories to preserve and develop company expertise, and to train new employees.

w_workflows.name: Evolve and sustain KM capabilities
w_workflows.description: Developing resources for improved knowledge management and knowledge engineering.

w_workflows.name: Create and manage organizational performance strategy
w_workflows.description: Creating and implementing a strategy for administering organizational performance. This process element calls upon the organization to create and administer a strategy for measuring, tracking, streamlining, and improving internal performance. It encompasses creating a blueprint for the tactical measurement of internal processes and work force improvement, in alignment with Employee Metrics Developed and Managed [10526].

w_workflows.name: Benchmark performance
w_workflows.description: Comparing organizational performance internally or externally with other organizations.

w_workflows.name: Evaluate process performance
w_workflows.description: Assessing process data, measures, and trends in an effort to evaluate process performance and identify possible improvements.

w_workflows.name: Determine environmental health and safety impacts
w_workflows.description: Determining the impact of EHS offering--and the procedures it employs to process them--on the environment at large, as well as the health and safety of employees. Evaluate the environmental impact of the organization's products, services, and operations. Conduct health, safety, and environmental audits.

w_workflows.name: Develop and execute functional EHS program
w_workflows.description: Identify the requirements for regulation and shareholders. Assess future risks and opportunities. Develop a policy for the EHS program. Record and manage EHS program events.

w_workflows.name: Train and educate functional employees
w_workflows.description: Conducting programs such as on-the-job training sessions, group training workshops, and online training.

w_workflows.name: Monitor and manage functional EHS management program
w_workflows.description: Managing the costs and benefits of EHS. Measure and report the performance of EHS. Implement plans for emergency response and pollution prevention. Provide EHS support.

w_workflows.name: Develop, Manage, and Deliver Analytics
w_workflows.description: Creating new and improving existing analytical capabilities to enhance data management pipeline.

w_activities.name: Request Drafted
w_activities.description: Line Manager created the manpower request.

w_activities.name: Offer Sent
w_activities.description: Offer prepared and sent to candidate.
